newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya extends voter registration exercise.
newsitem.headline: Kenya extends voter registration exercise.

text.p: Kenya's Electoral Commission has extended voter registration by two days from the original deadline of June 22, state media reported on Monday.

It said the extension was ordered after the commission discovered that thousands of Kenyans had not yet registered for elections due later this year. Registration will close at the end of the business day on Tuesday.
Residents across the East African country have complained that the process is slow and inefficient.
The National Electoral Commission said on Wednesday it had registered only 5.1 million voters in the country of 30 million people.
President Daniel arap Moi, 73, looks certain to extend his 19-year rule for five more years because of existing electoral rules and deep personal and ethnic splits within the opposition.
